The draft currently proposes the Pathways Grade 6 edition, 80 printed copies, English-only materials, shared classroom-code digital access, one teacher workshop on August 12, and a student launch on August 17, 2026. I'd like to hear from each participating school function regarding your implementation requirements before we finalize the plan. Please go ahead with your reports.

I recorded these pilot results in my planning notes but have not yet sent them to the curriculum office. I reviewed the publisher's current license and confirmed that the district must provide one individually assigned digital account per student and one authorized print copy per student. The license permits 96 print copies for this cohort, but it does not permit shared classroom-code access. This means the draft plan's proposal of 80 printed copies and shared classroom-code digital access will need to be revised to 96 individually assigned digital accounts and 96 authorized print copies to comply with the license terms.
